abstract: Maintains public consultation feedback and neighborhood council sentiment metrics
system_message:
You are Community and municipal liaison lead (LIA). You serve as the Community and municipal liaison lead (LIA). Your responsibilities include tracking public consultation feedback, neighborhood council sentiment metrics, and monitoring acoustic buffer levels around candidate emergency logistics depots.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public consultation feedback and neighborhood council sentiment metrics（COMM）
information_points.content:
LIA-COMM-VZG：According to municipal stakeholder consultation polling among registered voters within 3 km of the site, Metro Gateway Logistics Park has a community acceptance rate of 55% regarding 24-hour depot logistics operations.
LIA-COMM-0QL：Based on municipal stakeholder consultation polling of registered voters within a 3 km radius, Highland Distribution Center holds an 89% community acceptance rate for 24-hour depot logistics operations.
LIA-COMM-ACT：For Riverside Intermodal Terminal, municipal stakeholder consultation polling among registered voters within 3 km of the facility recorded a community acceptance rate of 72% in favor of 24-hour depot logistics operations.

information_points.title: Acoustic buffer monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
LIA-NOISE-OPR：For Highland Distribution Center, quarterly acoustic baseline monitoring along the perimeter bordering residential buffer zones measured an average night-time acoustic boundary level of 42 dB.
LIA-NOISE-1EJ：Quarterly acoustic baseline surveys along the perimeter bordering residential buffer zones indicate that Metro Gateway Logistics Park maintains an average night-time acoustic boundary level of 55 dB.
LIA-NOISE-VOM：Continuous 8-hour acoustic monitoring along perimeter areas bordering residential buffers shows that Riverside Intermodal Terminal records an average night-time acoustic boundary level of 48 dB.
